scientific_integrity: Analytic asymptotic theorem for separately measured orders 0,1,2 and radial disk restriction; proof is mathematical, checker gives finite corroboration only; no claim of nonlinear signal phase retrieval or exact finite-radius allocation.
scientific_limitations: The three-window large-radius asymptotic does not classify finite-radius optimizers. Global historical priority is uncertain; a 2023 multitaper thesis was accessible only in abstract.
title: A sharp second-order three-Hermite ambiguity conditioning law
